chapter.title: OF OFFENCES RELATING TO DOCUMENTSAND TO[2]*** PROPERTY MARKS

heading: Forgery for purpose of harming reputation.
text: Whoever commits forgery, [2][intending that the document or electronic record forged] shall harm the reputation of any party, or knowing that it is likely to be used for that purpose, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, and shall also be liable to fine.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
